title: Unauthorized AI Help Desk for Tesoro High School
excerpt: Responses grounded in the pages, PDFs, and Google Docs Tesoro High School publishes, plus district buses and lunch. 953 pages and files. Read 15 hours ago. Unofficial. Not grades.
content_html:
Responses grounded in everything Tesoro High School publishes — the pages, the PDFs, the Google Docs, the calendar — plus the district pages on buses, lunch, and counseling953 indexed  ·  updated 15 hours ago

/about

The school's search box cannot open a PDF. This one already did.

Tesoro's site has a search box, and it searches the site's own pages. But the bell schedule is a PDF. The tryout form is a Google Doc. The calendar is a feed. Those are where the answers actually live, and that search cannot see inside any of them. This one reads all of it, every day, and hands you the exact page — with the date it was read, so you know how old the answer is.

  • The same information, without the hunt. Every word here came from a page Tesoro or Capistrano Unified already published in public. If you would have found it yourself with enough clicking, it is here. If it sits behind a login — Aeries, Canvas, grades, homework — it is not.
  • It covers the district too. Buses, school lunch, IEP and special education, enrollment forms. Tesoro's site links out to those pages; this one searches them alongside the school's own, so a single question does not send you to two websites.
  • It always shows its work. Every result carries the page it came from and the day that page was read, because a page read yesterday can change today. If the school's pages do not say it, you get a miss rather than a guess. Connect it to ChatGPT or Claude and the assistant will still put the answer in its own words — check the page and the date it hands you.
  • It is not the school, and it is never the last word. For attendance, eligibility, a deadline, or anything medical, call the front office. Both numbers are at the top of every page.

953

Pages and files indexed

323

Web pages

228

PDFs

47

Google Docs, Sheets & Office files

Skip this paragraph unless you want to check the mechanism. A crawler identified as tesoro-help-ingest starts a fresh pass four times a day during the school-year window and once a day in summer. It reads tesoro.capousd.org, the Capistrano USD parent pages Tesoro does not publish, the district's Health-e Living nutrition site, and the Google Docs, Google Drive, and CloudFront addresses those pages link to for their PDFs and forms — one request per second, never more, text only and never images. PDFs and Office files are converted to text by a document-extraction service on Google Cloud Run. Nothing else leaves the crawler, and nothing about your visit is kept. Source freshness: Read 15 hours ago

776 of those files came through cleanly on the last pass. Anything that failed still appears in the full source list, marked as failed, because hiding a gap is worse than showing one. The crawler does not hunt for student names, rosters, or grades — but nothing stops the school from publishing a page that has them. Find one and email me; it comes out.

/connect

Connect your AI agent via MCP.

  • Claude
  • ChatGPT
  • OpenClaw
  • Hermes
  • Grok

MCP is just a read-only address you paste in once. Add it to the assistant you already use and it can answer Tesoro questions — sports, tutoring, counseling, bell schedules, enrollment — in the middle of any conversation, without you leaving the chat. Free in Claude on every plan. ChatGPT needs Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, or Edu, on the web. There is no account to make and no password to type. If a screen asks you to sign in to tesoro.help, you are on the wrong screen.

Paste this into ChatGPT or Claude

Connect to the Tesoro High School MCP at https://tesoro.help/mcp. No login. Answer from public school pages only. Cite the page and the date it was read. Not grades or anything behind a login. If you cannot connect, walk me through adding a custom connector here.

Unofficial. Confirm anything that matters with the school. The address inside is https://tesoro.help/mcp. Not grades, not homework, not anything behind a login.

Claude

claude.ai — Free, Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise

  1. Open Customize, then Connectors.
  2. Click +, then Add custom connector.
  3. Paste https://tesoro.help/mcp as the URL. Skip Advanced settings — there are no credentials to enter.
  4. Click Add.
  5. In any chat, press + at the lower left, choose Connectors, and switch on tesoro-help.

Free accounts may keep one custom connector; paid plans are not limited to one. On Team and Enterprise an owner adds it once for the whole organisation. Anthropic's instructions.

ChatGPT

Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, or Edu — web only

This is a read-only MCP: OpenAI's developer mode is for Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise, and Edu on the web. Not on Free, and not in the mobile app. If you are on Free, use Claude — it works there on every plan.

On a personal Plus or Pro account

  1. Open Settings → Security and login and switch on Developer mode.
  2. Open Settings → Apps → Create, or the plus menu in a chat.
  3. Give https://tesoro.help/mcp as the remote MCP server URL and set authentication to No Authentication.
  4. Save, then select it from the chat tools menu.

On a Business, Enterprise, or Edu workspace

An admin or owner enables developer mode and creates the app from Workspace settings → Apps → Create. Enterprise and Edu also need access granted under Permissions & Roles → Connected Data — then publish it from Workspace settings → Apps → Drafts → Publish.

Web only — MCP apps do not work in the ChatGPT mobile app. OpenAI moves these menus often; if yours looks different, follow their current guide and use the same URL.

OpenClaw · Hermes · GrokBot · Claude Code · Cursor · no password

claude mcp add --transport http tesoro https://tesoro.help/mcp

{ "mcpServers": { "tesoro": { "type": "http", "url": "https://tesoro.help/mcp" } } }

Same address. Two read-only tools: search_school and get_document. Add --scope user on Claude Code to keep it in every project. best-effort 600 requests per minute per IP.
